name: io.github.Servosity/appdirect-mcp
title: AppDirect MCP
description: AppDirect marketplace operations with an offline mirror and cross-company billing reconciliation.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the AppDirect API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID credential for the AppDirect MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the AppDirect MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the OAuth2 scope sent to AppDirect (default: ROLE_PARTNER ROLE_PARTNER_READ).

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on AppDirect requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: the AppDirect MCP server refuses every upload in this release (a user CSV, a catalog file, a product image or PDF) and names the CLI command to run instead, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
